entry.title: Lie Lie Lie
entry.summary:
Author: krono2011

Rating: Teen And Up AudiencesLanguage: EnglishWords: 328,664Chapters: 105/110Kudos: 1,565

Summary: Marinette Dupain-Cheng's life fell apart. Adrien's discovery that his father was Hawk Moth and that his girlfriend had lied destroyed their relationship. Her mother let her leave the city after Chrysalis's death, releasing her from despair. She didn't go to Shanghai. Uncle Wang needed help with his new restaurant. Goodbye, City of Love, hello Gotham, Capital of Crime. Damian Wayne does not get “dumped.” However, with the high-profile Wayne Gala looming and his brothers actively plotting to mock his solo status, he requires an immediate tactical maneuver: a pretend girlfriend. His designated target? Maps Mizoguchi. Approaching a familiar silhouette with raven hair beneath a tree, he coldly issues a command for a romantic alliance. However, when the girl turns around, he realizes it isn't Maps. Instead, it's a thoroughly bewildered French transfer student clutching a macaron. A lesser man would apologize for the mistake. Damian Wayne? He simply doubles down. She has the right hair color, and she is a variable he can control. “You,” he decides, utterly refusing to admit defeat. “You are an acceptable substitute. Don’t be late.”

entry.title: Academic Misconduct
entry.summary:
Author: NeZepellini

Rating: MatureLanguage: EnglishWords: 50,898Chapters: 12/35Kudos: 94

Summary: Life is not going as planned for Marinette Dupain-Chang. When she was 14, she'd honestly thought that by now she'd be a famous fashion designer and she'd be living out the rest of her life with Adrien in all her hamster-loving glory. At 25, all she wants to do is get her MBA and launch MDC to new heights. No romance, unnecessary rivals, or convoluted plans. But life has a funny sort of irony to it. Or, where Marinette fake-dates Damian, someone she cannot stand for the life of her, until it doesn't feel like fake-dating anymore.This is my take on a character study. I just want to warn people that Marinette isn't a good person, far from it. She is flawed, she does a lot of shitty things, but there are consequences. Overall, this fic focuses on her personality traits and exaggerates them slightly to show really how they impact her life. I want to apologise for any butchering of the characters I may do (It's not an excuse), but I do have reasons for doing so. Updates on the first of every month (for now, update rate may increase as time goes on.)

entry.title: The Soulmate Story
entry.summary:
Author: Legacy_K

Rating: Not RatedLanguage: EnglishWords: 12,304Chapters: 16/16Kudos: 95

Summary: In a world where floating orbs expose the truth of every bond, secrets don't stay buried for long. Years ago, the day the orbs appeared nearly tore society apart-gold marked soulmates, blue marked friendship, black marked enemies. Simple. Brutal. Unforgiving. Marinette Dupain-Cheng learned early that the colors never lied. So when the balance of Paris shattered and the Miraculous fell into the wrong hands, she made a choice no hero was meant to make: she ended Hawkmoth, she ended Adrien Agreste, and she took back the power that was never meant to be theirs. Now the world calls her many things like murderer, traitor, threat and with the Justice League closing in and Paris no longer safe, Marinette lives in the shadows, carrying blood on her hands and silence in her chest. The orbs still hover. Still judge. Still reveal truths she would rather not see. Because fate isn't finished with her yet when Marinette finally meets the quiet, sharp-eyed boy whose orb burns pure gold beside hers, the world might just break all over again.

Rating: Teen And Up AudiencesLanguage: EnglishWords: 251,981Chapters: 95/98Kudos: 687

Summary: Five years Damian waited for the last Miraculous Ladybug manga, and the ending sucks. Enraged, he boasted he could write a better story. A mischievous, fifth-dimensional imp quickly appears and gives him a chance to prove his claim. To prevent a disappointing ending, he must change the plot as he sees fit. What would a genius detective, Robin, do in the MLB Universe, to cause Chaos of course! ​He wakes up in a world where he is dead, but Alfred is his living ally. With just seven days until the plot kicks off, Damian dedicates himself to healing the fractured Batfamily, slowly putting the pieces back together. But he can multitask. To prevent the Love Square, he decides to aggressively befriend Marinette Dupain-Cheng the only way a Wayne knows how: by replacing her friends with competent ones and burying her under a mountain of gifts. Who knew purchasing platonic affection required so much cashmere? (I am currently writing the final arc. )
